conclusions: All three standalone models retain raw category phenomena.291/292 have an attack flag;293 does not. Model293 guardian-familyNeptune does not become attack DTO guardian art or a player source.

190 is the only special reaction for these phenomena. Physical/miracle bounce/reflect/block matching does not apply; some such cards can still serve ordinary DEF when their values and the incoming attribute allow it.

291 Light disallows ordinary DEF until189 filters the attribute.292 Dark permits ordinary DEF selection; the server damage calculation is not executed by this predicate oracle.293 nonattack permits190 but not ordinaryDEF/filter.

187 and other zero-DEF armor counters can be admitted by the visible ordinary-defense predicate for attack payloads, depending on attribute/filter/Flash. Admission does not establish a valid source-free counter target or body effect.

Frame.fu accepts a supplied null source object separately from a decoded numeric playerId. A.p6 defaults absent/noninteger playerId to0; the actual nextAttack caller normally performs roster lookup, so numeric0 is not a no-source wire tag.

dealDamage/boostHP event.playerId0 means currentpane gan(), even if realplayer0 exists elsewhere. Explicit nonzero event IDs use roster lookup. Darkdamage always sets currentpane HP0. These numeric handlers do not finalize dead status.

The generic reflect receiver requires the old source-pane player. A forced null-source render fails before it can establish a return address; a real player0 source returns to player0. Local source-free cancellation is a new explicit execution rule.
HP50 is clipped by actual c5.eV to99, but the singular boostHP event does not establish whether a server would send it once or for multiple recipients.
limitations: Environment/origin-null annotations are adapter semantics, not fields decoded from the official attack DTO or evidence that a source-null network event is emitted by the server.
All response-after-filter lists are raw append probes; the filter prefix itself must first be legal, especially for nonattack293 and Flash single-card contexts.

The received amount is supplied by events: this oracle does not derive ATK minus DEF, sample75percent, chooseDarkCloud hits, generate counter/death/guardian effects, or prove ordinary owner/timing/gift/cutoff semantics.

The 190 cancellation and source-targeted counter skip/self-MP exception are explicit local policies. UI acceptance or a failed artificially source-null render is not proof of the corresponding server rule.
The input scenes include deliberately transient HP0/dead combinations to isolate numeric display behavior. They are not claims of legal executable Match states.

No network, account, DOM, timer or Dart application startup runs. Widgets/text/animation and Future scheduling are stubbed while actual decoder, frame, summary, response predicate and numeric/control-flow helpers run unchanged.
